analyticalMisses.summary: Team totals (0-3, -$55) and parlays (0-2, -$20) combined for -$75 against a day that was otherwise +$14.48 on core F5+ML -- team totals require a true scoring thesis, not a side opinion paired with a threshold.
TB F5: a small-sample/uncertain opposing starter situation should have reduced confidence before betting a 57%-displayed favorite.
AZ F5: faded an established starter largely on recent/underlying metrics looking attackable -- insufficient justification on its own.
NYY ML + NYY 5+ runs concentrated one bad thesis across two same-game legs (DUPLICATE_THESIS).
AZ F5 + AZ 4+ runs similarly concentrated one thesis across two same-game legs (DUPLICATE_THESIS).
MIL ML around a coin-flip displayed price (52%) did not carry enough independent justification to deserve meaningful exposure.

analyticalWins.summary: F5 sides went 4-2 for +$45.22 (+23.19% ROI) -- the day's clearly strongest family; straight-side handicapping was not the source of the day's loss.

gameLevelConcentration.note: NYY ML + NYY 5+ runs concentrated one bad thesis on a single team/game -- both legs lost. DUPLICATE_THESIS.
AZ F5 + AZ 4+ runs similarly concentrated one thesis on AZ -- both legs lost. DUPLICATE_THESIS.

BAL ML WON while BAL 6+ runs LOST -- direct evidence that liking a team's side is not the same claim as liking that team to clear a high scoring threshold. MODERATELY_CORRELATED (same team, different scoring thesis), not duplicate.

performanceByMarketFamily.note: F5 sides were the strongest family: SD/BOS/MIN/TEX F5 won, TB and AZ F5 lost. Straight-side handicapping was NOT the day's main loss source.

MIL ML and NYY ML lost, BAL ML won. User's own exact-cost-basis figure for this family was -$30.74 (cost basis $104.99, using NYY ML's $39.99 share-card cost); this repository's canonical-whole-dollar-stake basis gives -$30.75 on $105 risk -- a $0.01 artifact of the deliberate $39.99-share-card-cost -> $40-canonical-stake rule (docs/KALSHI_FEE_AWARE_EXECUTION_ECONOMICS.md), not a data error.
Team totals went 0-3: NYY 5+, AZ 4+, BAL 6+ all lost. Combined with the parlay legs, team totals + parlays produced most of the day's damage.

5-leg combo (TB F5/BOS F5/MIN F5/TEX F5/BAL ML) went 4/5, losing only on TB F5; 2-leg combo (AZ F5/NYY ML) went 0/2. Neither combo settles automatically (MANUALCOMBO tickers have no real Kalshi market) -- both remain status=pending in the objective ledger with confirmedReceipt* evidence carrying the true LOSS/LOSS result.

processErrors.summary: BAL ML won while BAL 6+ runs lost -- direct evidence that 'I like this team's side' is NOT equivalent to 'I like this team to clear a high scoring threshold'. Team-total legs must carry their own independent scoring thesis, not just ride a side opinion.

proposedInvestigations.summary: Compare the full team-total threshold ladder (4+/5+/6+ etc.) probability-to-payout relationship per game rather than defaulting to one headline threshold.
